name: astra_iterative_interventions_v1
purpose: Compare bounded iterative interventions in a frozen pi05 prior with simulator reset access
development_stopping: After a successful baseline, continue within the same five-attempt cap until one candidate rollout executes for each arm; record rejected proposals and their costs

development_embedding_probe.guidance_suffix: Guidance: Focus on the target object and its destination.

noise.reference: same-condition inverse of policy-generated full internal trajectory
noise.reuse: fixed recovered latent plus candidate delta, under fresh observations throughout the rollout

feedback.success: simulator binary task success after an attempted rollout
feedback.frames: four evenly spaced raw observations from the latest rollout

stopping: first success or five attempts including the common identity baseline; a rejected provider proposal consumes its attempt and token budget without a rollout
claim_scope: Follow-up adaptation evaluation on new seed19 resets; tasks and prior seed7 outcomes have already been observed, and checkpoint training overlap is unknown
